own_solution.law: Double Doppler shift from a receding reflector, then a receding receiver: f_rec = f (c - w)/(c + w) * (c - v)/c; df = f - f_rec
assumptions: reflection with no frequency change in the panel's rest frame

notes: Base 89.5812 Hz and R answer 111.962 Hz match my pass 1. Checked other values: conveyor 4.8 m/s -> 109.851 Hz, 5.8 m/s -> 114.074 Hz, both correct. The crest-timing derivation for the distance is right: T_(n+1)-T_n = (c+w)c/((c-v)(c-w)) * (1/f), independent of q, so C is a fair label (it agrees with my pass-1 choice). Minimal pairs T02E2/TBF04 (earlier run vs this run) and T4BE2/TA0C8 (toolbox vs recorder) share 5.3 m/s and differ only in attachment. TA134 and TA6A4 are declared numeral-free controls. The authors' relation f2 = f1*(c - v)/(c + w) is the same as my expression.
